name: alphaxiv_paper_fetch
description: Search alphaXiv for a query, then render a paper's abs page in the singleton browser, wait for the SPA to finish, and save it as Markdown plus its figures. State: query (search text, optional), paper_url (alphaXiv /abs/<id> URL, required to save), out_dir (write target, must be under policy.allow_paths), selector (optional content root).

proceed.instructions: Open alphaXiv search for the query?

with.expression: (() => new Promise((resolve) => { const deadline = Date.now() + 20000; const collect = () => { const seen = new Set(); const out = []; for (const a of document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/abs/"]')) { const u = a.href.split('#')[0].split('?')[0]; if (seen.has(u)) continue; seen.add(u); const card = a.closest('article,li,div'); const t = ((card && card.innerText) || a.innerText || '').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,160); out.push({url: u, title: t}); if (out.length >= 10) break; } return out; }; const tick = () => { const r = collect(); if (r.length || Date.now() > deadline) resolve({count: r.length, results: r, url: location.href}); else setTimeout(tick, 500); }; tick(); }))()

done.instructions: Render and save the paper to disk?
